name: Cosense (formerly Scrapbox)
description_en:
The product recorded as Scrapbox is now presented as Cosense on its official domain. It is a linked team knowledge workspace with lightweight markup, bidirectional and two-hop links, real-time editing and public/private projects. The record keeps its historical slug while explaining the current product identity.

Pricing depends on project visibility, purpose and ownership. Public use, private personal/education use and private organisational use must not be collapsed into one free/paid label.
description_zh:
原记录名为 Scrapbox 的产品，当前官方域名将其展示为 Cosense。它是关联式团队知识工作区，提供轻量标记、双向及两跳链接、实时编辑与公开／私密项目。本记录保留历史 slug，并说明当前产品身份。

费用取决于项目可见性、用途和归属；公开使用、私密个人／教育使用与私密组织使用不能合并为一个笼统免费／付费标签。

core_features.explanation_en: Expose incoming and nearby linked-page context.
core_features.explanation_zh: 展示传入及邻近关联页面上下文。

core_features.explanation_en: Edit together and reference a specific line.
core_features.explanation_zh: 共同编辑并引用具体行。

core_features.explanation_en: Use public/private projects and documented access roles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用公开／私密项目及文档所列访问角色。

en: Connect project experience notes and shared glossary pages.
zh: 连接项目经验笔记与共享术语页。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor cloud projects; separately documented on-premises option with unverified terms.
Deployment.zh: 厂商云项目；文档另列本地部署选项，条款未核实。

steps.en: Choose project ownership and visibility before adding content.
steps.zh: 添加内容前先确定项目归属与可见性。

steps.en: Create connected glossary/project pages and invite only the intended members.
steps.zh: 创建关联术语／项目页面，仅邀请所需成员。

steps.en: Check per-project billing, permissions and export/recovery before wider rollout.
steps.zh: 扩大使用前核对按项目计费、权限和导出／恢复。

items.en: The features page documents Google/G Suite authentication for cloud and an on-premises option with other identity providers. It does not establish a freely downloadable open-source server or the commercial terms of that option. Check account membership, public exposure, export/restore and access revocation on a representative project. Cosense fits shared connected knowledge; a file-based private notebook or a formal document approval system has different requirements. No recovery test, SSO setup or independent security audit was performed.
items.zh: 功能页说明云端使用 Google／G Suite 认证，本地部署可配合其他身份提供商；这不证明有免费可下载的开源服务端，也未确认该选项商业条款。应在代表性项目核对成员、公开暴露、导出／恢复及撤销访问。Cosense 适合共享关联知识；基于文件的个人笔记或正式文档审批系统有不同要求。未进行恢复测试、SSO 配置或独立安全审计。

pricing.billing_basis: Business users per project monthly; public/personal purpose conditions differ.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Public projects free; qualifying personal/education free; Business ¥1,100/user/month/project including tax after free page threshold.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 公开项目免费；合资格个人／教育使用免费；Business 超过免费页面阈值后每用户每项目每月 1,100 日元含税。

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_zh: 通过关联页面构建上下文
sections.en: For an illustrative team glossary, create a page for a project, link the people and concepts it uses, then write short experience notes that reference those pages. A backlink exposes incoming context; two-hop links reveal pages linked from a related page. Real-time co-editing and links to specific lines can support discussion. These mechanisms help navigate relationships, but do not verify the truth of what colleagues write.
sections.zh: 例如团队术语库可为项目创建页面，链接涉及的人物与概念，再写引用这些页面的简短经验记录。反向链接展示传入上下文，两跳链接展示关联页面进一步链接的内容。实时共编和行级链接可辅助讨论。这些机制帮助浏览关系，但不验证同事所写内容的真实性。

sections.title_en: Public and private projects change both risk and price
sections.title_zh: 公开与私密项目同时影响风险与费用
sections.en: The feature page says projects are private to invited members until a creator/admin makes them public. The pricing page says public projects are free even for work, while personal/non-profit/education cases have their own free scope and detailed ownership exceptions. Do not make a confidential team project public merely to qualify for free use. The free educational rule excludes some administration/for-profit uses, so review the actual owner and activity.
sections.zh: 功能页说明项目默认仅受邀成员可见，创建者／管理员可改为公开。定价页说明公开项目即使用于工作也免费，个人／非营利／教育场景有独立免费范围和详细归属例外。不能为了免费资格把保密团队项目公开。免费教育规则排除部分行政／营利用途，因此应核对实际归属与活动。

sections.title_en: Business billing counts people per project
sections.title_zh: 商务按项目内用户计费
sections.en: The Business page lists ¥1,100 JPY per user per month including tax, charged for each project. Its example of three people in three projects totals ¥9,900/month. Business can start with 100 pages; inviting members can extend this to at most 300 before payment is needed for unlimited pages. That is a usage threshold, not a fixed-duration trial or an unlimited free business workspace. Large-project discounts require contact.
sections.zh: Business 页面列每用户每月 1,100 日元含税，每个项目分别计费。示例中三人在三个项目内共每月 9,900 日元。商务可从 100 页开始，邀请成员可扩展至最多 300 页，之后需付款才能不限页面。这是用量阈值，不是固定天数试用，也不是不限量免费商务工作区。大型项目优惠需联系。

sections.title_en: Cloud and on-premises are different configurations
sections.title_zh: 云端与本地部署是不同配置
sections.en: The features page documents Google/G Suite authentication for cloud and an on-premises option with other identity providers. It does not establish a freely downloadable open-source server or the commercial terms of that option. Check account membership, public exposure, export/restore and access revocation on a representative project. Cosense fits shared connected knowledge; a file-based private notebook or a formal document approval system has different requirements. No recovery test, SSO setup or independent security audit was performed.
sections.zh: 功能页说明云端使用 Google／G Suite 认证，本地部署可配合其他身份提供商；这不证明有免费可下载的开源服务端，也未确认该选项商业条款。应在代表性项目核对成员、公开暴露、导出／恢复及撤销访问。Cosense 适合共享关联知识；基于文件的个人笔记或正式文档审批系统有不同要求。未进行恢复测试、SSO 配置或独立安全审计。

research_gaps.en: On-premises commercial terms, current export/restore behaviour, identity-provider configuration and actual permissions were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试本地部署商业条款、当前导出／恢复行为、身份提供商配置或实际权限。

content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research; original English synthesis with matching Chinese sections. Workflow examples and evaluation advice were not executed.
